item.title: One Hash Bloom Filters
item.description:
📝 Traditional Bloom Filters A bloom filter is an array of bits and k hash functions. that uses even more math to show how to do bloom filters using only a single hash. With this technique in hand, I made jcalabro/gloom, a one-hash bloom filter (OHBF) implementation in go.
🔗 Read more: https://calabro.io/ohbf

item.title: Ukraine claims first drone evacuation of wounded soldier
item.description:
📝 An injured soldier being evacuated by drone in video shared Monday by Ukraine's 92nd Separate Assault Brigade. The drone carefully lowers him, and the drone operator greets him with “Welcome back to the ground. ” The video also shows blurred faces of drone operators who carried out the mission.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nbcnews.com/world/ukraine/ukraine-first-drone-evacuation-wounded-soldier-frontlines-hexacopter-rcna604310

item.title: Honey, I shrunk the TV
item.description:
📝 Graphic design is my passion Preface Some time ago, when I was deciding what sound system I wanted for my restroom, I stumbled across Samsung's (At that time, flagship) Q990D soundbar. After some online searching, I found out that I could leverage Samsung's Q-Symphony to drive both the soundbar (And it's satellites) and the 2 Music Studio 7s on my setup. It kinda suprised me because it's the first device I ever encounter that has this "limitation".
🔗 Read more: https://cakehonolulu.github.io/honey-i-shrunk-the-tv/
